newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH SHELL RAISES DIESEL PRICE ON MONDAY.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH SHELL RAISES DIESEL PRICE ON MONDAY.

text.p: Royal Dutch/Shell unit Shell Nederland BV said on Friday it will raise its retail prices for diesel in the Netherlands by one cent per litre with effect from January 6.
The move reflects changes in international product prices and the value of the dollar against the guilder, the company said. It added that gasoline prices would remain unchanged.
From Monday the recommended price of diesel at Shell's self-service stations goes up to 1.53 guilders per litre.
